hero.badge: Now with NVMe storage in 4 regions
hero.subtitle: Pick your game, drag the sliders for RAM, CPU and storage, and your server is online in under a minute. No contracts, cancel anytime.

items.quote: Moved our 60-player SMP over in an evening. Zero lag since, and the console in the dashboard is a life saver.
items.name: Andrei P.

items.quote: Wipe day used to be stressful. Now I schedule it and go stream. The Rust servers just hold up.
items.name: Kira

items.quote: Being able to add 4 GB of RAM for a weekend event and drop it on Monday is exactly what we needed.
items.name: Mihai D.

items.q: How fast is my server online?
items.a: Most servers are installed and ready within 60 seconds after checkout. Large games like ARK can take a few minutes to download.
Yes. Increase or decrease RAM, CPU and storage at any time; we pro-rate the difference on your next invoice.
No. Roblox runs all experiences on its own infrastructure and does not allow third-party hosting, so we cannot offer it.
Your server keeps running until the end of the paid period. You can download a full backup before it is removed.
Card payments through Stripe are coming soon. During the preview, checkout is simulated and no money is charged.
